title: Pump Motor Overload
fullDescription:
E01 occurs on Zodiac robotic cleaners (CX, MX9, RC) when the suction motor exceeds amperage limits, usually from clogged filter cartridges or impeller jam.

Clean filters and inspect.

title: Drive Motor Overload
fullDescription:
E02 indicates the drive motor is overloaded. Common causes include debris in tracks, worn brushes, or dragging on liner.

Free the wheels.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wheels
fixSteps.instruction: Spin wheels by hand and remove debris.

title: Cleaner Out of Water
fullDescription:
E03 means the cleaner cannot sense water. Started outside pool, lost prime, or broken impeller.

Never run dry.

title: Cable Communication Failure
fullDescription: E05 indicates the controller cannot communicate with the robot. Inspect the floating cable for damage and the connectors for corrosion.

title: Power Supply Fault
fullDescription: E07 indicates the controller detected internal supply fault. Cycle power; replace if recurring.

title: Cable Polarity Reversed
fullDescription: E08 indicates polarity at the robot connector is wrong, often after DIY cable repair. Genuine cable required.

title: Pump Motor Stalled
fullDescription:
E09 indicates pump motor failure to spin. Often due to mineral seizure after long storage.

Manually rotate impeller to free.

title: High Mains Voltage
fullDescription: E11 indicates the supply voltage exceeds rated range. Confirm outlet; consider surge protector.

title: Low Mains Voltage
fullDescription: E12 indicates input voltage below threshold. Avoid extension cords or share-circuits.

title: Internal Firmware Error
fullDescription: E15 indicates a firmware/software fault. Apply latest firmware via iAquaLink app or service for update.
